The PR patch excerpt is truncated, so the new v0.10.13 candidate section is only partly visible. The visible head hunk (lines 11-45) is documentation only: a Gemma 4 loop guard that closes a looping thought and lets the model answer (#2040), and a pair-setup status fix so the joining Mac does not show "Stopped" while the leader downloads (#2042). No code, protocol, key, attestation, authorization or cache-storage change is visible in the supplied evidence.

The base text mentions security-relevant items, but these are pre-existing behavior and not regressions from this PR: prefix-cache SSD checkpoints (related to T-041, with Nemotron Super native precision), the local add-on hold, update rollback and watchdog behavior, and the unauthenticated-coordinator-ignored `refusal_reason` fields. None of these are changed in the visible head diff.

Unverified: the rest of the v0.10.13 section, past the truncated excerpt, and the actual implementations behind #2040 and #2042, including the loop-exit-thinking guard and the stop-propagation change to the leader's start. The next pass should check those source files if they are in other batches. A guard that injects a thought-close and continues generation should respect the request's max_tokens budget and must not apply to logprobs requests, as the changelog claims. The pair stop propagation should be checked for authorization of the stop request, which relates to TB-002 and T-059/T-060 style local-control concerns. This changelog-only excerpt gives no evidence of regression, and the threat model does not need updating from it.
